auth_model: Each remote interop sample requires explicit operator confirmation of target, send decision, and credential class; no secret, token, production account, or account identifier may be stored.
endpoint_or_authority_scope: Sampling is limited to one explicitly confirmed external-test-endpoint, hosted test collector, or remote collector class per sample; no broader OpenAI, MCP, A2A, or hosted interop claim is allowed.
redaction_or_boundary_model: Record only endpoint_scope, network_exported, remote_status, failure mode, redaction state, withheld data class, review command, and bounded evidence refs; no raw trace payload, request/response body, prompt, transcript, secret, runtime path, or raw tool output.
cost_or_stop_boundary: Default to one probe and no automatic retry; stop on auth failure, HTTP error, rate limit, unexpected payload, or cost uncertainty unless the operator gives a fresh confirmation.
decision: Approve bounded real remote-interop sampling for GAP-TRACE-REMOTE-INTEROP through the sample append and outcome review gates; keep checks advisory until accepted real samples prove behavior.
note: Approves bounded remote interop sampling only; does not prove external collector, OpenAI hosted trace, MCP, A2A, or default network export.

auth_model: Only the current main agent/operator may record bounded incident summaries; subagents, workers, handoffs, or tool outputs cannot expand authority or replace user confirmation.
endpoint_or_authority_scope: Sampling is limited to local repo harness and locally verifiable incidents; no remote agent, A2A endpoint, hosted worker, external send, deployment, secret operation, or autonomous retry surface is approved.
redaction_or_boundary_model: Record only loop trigger, stop condition, open-loop status, owner decision, review command, and bounded evidence refs; do not store raw transcript, prompts, secrets, raw tool output, runtime paths, or external payload bodies.
cost_or_stop_boundary: Each sample must record stop condition, retry or validation-loop boundary, whether a checkpoint/new session/cancel path was used, and the owner decision; sampling cannot justify continued cascading execution.
decision: Approve bounded real-incident sampling for GAP-AGENTIC-CASCADE-STOP through the red-team sample append and outcome review gates; keep checks advisory until accepted real samples prove behavior.
note: Approves bounded local incident sampling only; does not prove remote agent, A2A, hosted interop, or automatic cascade enforcement.
